commands.command:
set -eu
id fleet-https >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd --system --home-dir /var/lib/fleet-https --create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin fleet-https
install -d -o fleet-https -g fleet-https -m 755 /var/lib/fleet-https/www
printf '%s\n' 'Fleet HTTPS service on node2' > /var/lib/fleet-https/www/index.html
chown fleet-https:fleet-https /var/lib/fleet-https/www/index.html
chown root:fleet-https /etc/fleet-https /etc/fleet-https/node2.crt /etc/fleet-https/node2.key
chmod 750 /etc/fleet-https
chmod 640 /etc/fleet-https/node2.crt /etc/fleet-https/node2.key
install -d -m 755 /usr/local/libexec
cat > /usr/local/libexec/fleet-https-server.py <<'PYEOF'
#!/usr/bin/python3
import http.server
import os
import ssl

os.chdir('/var/lib/fleet-https/www')
server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', 8443), http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler)
context = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
context.minimum_version = ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_2
context.load_cert_chain('/etc/fleet-https/node2.crt', '/etc/fleet-https/node2.key')
server.socket = context.wrap_socket(server.socket, server_side=True)
server.serve_forever()
PYEOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/libexec/fleet-https-server.py
cat > /etc/systemd/system/fleet-https.service <<'UNITEOF'
[Unit]
Description=Fleet internal HTTPS service
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=fleet-https
Group=fleet-https
ExecStart=/usr/local/libexec/fleet-https-server.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
ReadOnlyPaths=/etc/fleet-https /var/lib/fleet-https/www

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNITEOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now fleet-https.service
systemctl is-active fleet-https.service
systemctl is-enabled fleet-https.service
ss -tlnp | grep ':8443 '
